en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge spanning a calm river, with triangular cutwaters and a tower-like structure rising from the bridge deck. On the far bank stand low houses and, in the distance to the right, a large Ottoman mosque with multiple slender minarets. The upper margin bears French text identifying the scene and an additional inscription in Ottoman Turkish.
